title: Replace scheduler_providers.dart's duplicate _localDateOnly with the existing DateUtils.extractLocalDate
why: _localDateOnly (`final l = utc.toLocal(); return DateTime(l.year, l.month, l.day);`) is a byte-for-byte reimplementation of DateUtils.extractLocalDate, which is already imported and used dozens of times elsewhere in this exact file (e.g. line 543 `DateUtils.extractLocalDate(now)`). Two near-identical local-date helpers in the same file is exactly the kind of drift that produced the R4-1 class of bugs this feature has repeatedly had to fix — a future edit to one 'extract local date' helper (e.g. a DST or leap-second fix) won't automatically apply to the other.
recommendation: Delete _localDateOnly and call DateUtils.extractLocalDate at its two call sites instead.
acceptance_criteria: _localDateOnly is removed from scheduler_providers.dart; its call sites use DateUtils.extractLocalDate.
